func save(_ i: Int) async {}

// CASE qualified_plain expect=pass
func q1(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    _Concurrency.Task {
      await save(item)
    }
  }
}

// CASE qualified_plain_capture expect=pass
func q2(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    _Concurrency.Task { [item] in
      await save(item)
    }
  }
}

// CASE qualified_generic_nocapture expect=pass
func q3(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    _Concurrency.Task<Void, Never> {
      await save(item)
    }
  }
}

// CASE qualified_generic_capture_bound expect=pass
func q4(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    let task = _Concurrency.Task<Void, Never> { [item] in
      await save(item)
    }
    _ = task
  }
}

// CASE generic_capture_bound expect=pass
func q5(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    let task = Task<Void, Never> { [item] in
      await save(item)
    }
    _ = task
  }
}

// CASE qualified_detached expect=pass
func q6(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    _Concurrency.Task.detached {
      await save(item)
    }
  }
}

// CASE qualified_plain_bound expect=pass
func q7(_ items: [Int]) {
  var tasks: [_Concurrency.Task<Void, Never>] = []
  for item in items {
    let task = _Concurrency.Task { await save(item) }
    tasks.append(task)
  }
  _ = tasks
}

// CASE qualified_handle_value expect=fire
func q8(_ items: [Int]) async {
  for item in items {
    let task = _Concurrency.Task { await save(item) }
    await task.value
  }
}
